record.question: What is the cardinal principle governing the assessment of responsibility of an officer regarding responsibility for losses to government?
options: That losses are unavoidable and may be pardoned if the officer acted quickly.
That responsibility arises only when the loss is reported by Audit.
That every Government servant must exercise the same vigilance, care, and prudence in handling public funds as a person of ordinary prudence would exercise in handling their own money.
That responsibility is fixed upon the officer who directly handles cash
